description: Gares routières autocar en Occitanie is a dataset listed in Occitanie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Listes des gares routières autocar de la région Occitanie. Coverage: Occitanie. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are transport, autocar, gare, routière. The portal shows 3 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-laregion-fr-portal.
